content: Implemented the contact form and deployed it live at https://staging.example-tasks.dev/contact. All fields are validated client-side and server-side (required fields plus valid email format) before the message is sent. Code change: https://github.com/example-org/site-contact-form/pull/42. Approach: added a ContactForm component, a small serverless endpoint that validates input and forwards it to the team mailer, plus unit tests for the validation logic.

Added the contact form, live at https://staging.example-tasks.dev/contact-v2. I pushed the code and will open the actual PR shortly -- commit / patch notes here: https://paste.example.dev/patch-notes-8841. The form validates email format and required fields before submitting.
I completed the contact form and deployed it. All fields are validated before submission. The code change is committed and ready for review. I also included a short write-up describing my approach.
